title: Adopt the game-kit contract for state, actions, and rules
context: Implement the shared `game-kit` contract so Sudoku exposes one deterministic

spec.summary: Adopt the game-kit contract for state, actions, and rules
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Illegal placements return `None` and never panic.
Replaying the same puzzle and moves produces identical state.
A conformance test covers initial state, legal actions, and apply.
The state can be exported for the solver.
Map Sudoku rules to the traits.
Same puzzle + moves = same state hash.
